notes.title: Update v1.0.3: Freezing issue fixed!
notes.content:
Hello all!

We've just pushed an update for Guilded Hearts that fixes some issues with the game, [b]primarily with freezing on different routes.[/b]

It should be possible to play all routes through now without issues. However, we're keeping on top of your feedback and attacking all bugs as they roll in, so please keep sending in reports! (We greatly apologize for any issues you may encounter.)

Thank you for your support thus far!

tags.bug: - primarily with freezing on different routes.
